{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.06

|eff= local

|gr1= Event Handlers

|descr= Removes all UserAction event handlers of the given type which were added by [[addUserActionEventHandler]].

{{Feature|important|This command also resets the Event Handler creation index to 0.}}

|s1= [[removeAllUserActionEventHandlers]] [keyName, eventType]

|p1= keyName: [[String]] - see [[inputAction/actions]]

|p2= eventType: [[String]] - event name; see [[Arma 3: Event Handlers#UserAction Event Handlers|UserAction Event Handlers]]. Can be one of:
* "Activate"
* "Deactivate"
* "Analog"

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>removeAllUserActionEventHandlers ["Reload", "Activate"];</sqf>

|seealso= [[addUserActionEventHandler]] [[removeUserActionEventHandler]] [[Arma 3: Event Handlers#UserAction Event Handlers|UserAction Event Handlers]]
}}
